_comment: Observed timeline of a live ARM add-region followed by remove-region on tomasvaron-h2sweep (single-write, continuous backup on), polling the account read every 5s. Records only *distinct* observed states. This is the evidence behind ENDPOINT_ABSENCE_GRACE in location_state_store.rs and RegionStatus::Draining in the in-memory emulator.

notes: ARM readLocations listed 'East US 2' with provisioningState=Creating within seconds, but the data-plane account read did NOT advertise it for another ~12 minutes.
For ~40 seconds the gateway FLAPPED: successive account reads alternated between ['Central US'] and ['Central US','East US 2'].
writableLocations never included the new region (failoverPriority 1 on a single-write account).

etag.notes: No `_etag` in the account payload and no ETag response header at any point, on either the global or the regional endpoint, for x-ms-version 2018-12-31 and 2020-07-15.

notes: The regional endpoint began returning 403/1008 only ~20 SECONDS after the ARM PATCH — long before the global account read stopped advertising the region.
This creates a real window where a client gets 403/1008, refreshes topology in response, and receives a payload that STILL contains the dead region. Modeled by RegionStatus::Draining.
The regional endpoint flapped too: an HTTP 200 was observed at 23:59:17 in between 403s.
The regional DNS name stopped resolving (NXDOMAIN) at ~00:03:25, after the 403 phase.
The global account read flapped between one and two readable locations for ~7 minutes before settling.
